name: Upper / Lower Hypertrophy
description: Four workouts a week, two for the upper body and two for the lower, built for muscle growth. Each muscle is trained twice a week with a mix of barbell, dumbbell, cable and machine work. Twelve weeks: volume rises through two blocks, week 9 is a deload and the last block is the hardest. Add weight when every set reaches the top of the rep range.

phases.name: Accumulate
phases.description: Moderate weights and higher reps to build volume and learn the exercises

exercises.name: Pull-Up
exercises.notes: Use an assisted machine or band if needed

phases.name: Intensify
phases.description: One more set and heavier weights in fewer reps

exercises.name: Pull-Up
exercises.notes: Use an assisted machine or band if needed

phases.name: Deload
phases.description: One lighter week: fewer sets and lighter weights, so you start the next phase recovered

exercises.name: Pull-Up
exercises.notes: Use an assisted machine or band if needed

phases.name: Overreach
phases.description: The hardest block: four sets on everything, close to failure

exercises.name: Pull-Up
